about: The behaviour scenarios inside the rebuild's slice: each touches only what the rebuild draws so far (the shell, the desk, the pure-data modules, the Pedalboard with its pure-data pedals and side unit). Every other scenario sets up, operates or checks a part of the page a later work package builds (a module with a bespoke part, the prompt, the lyrics, the picker, workflows, generation, drag and drop, the overlays); docs/09-architecture.md lists them by package. Chosen by reading each scenario; tools/behaviour/run.mjs --slice runs these.

scenarios.why: The engine button and its panel's five cards: arrows, Enter, Escape, a click outside.
The side panels collapse to their rails and expand, and the choice is kept over a reload.
Below 1400px the Modules panel opens over the desk and closes on a press outside or Escape; Lab below 1600px puts the Workflows panel on its rail.
The toast: holds while hovered, its action, its dismiss button, a replaced message.
A pedal switched off stays drawn bypassed, with focus inside; the board's count.
StableStep's knobs keep their cells when Source blend changes; the fixed seed takes only a seed.
Pending (F-20): rapid tier and theme switching leaves no error.
Pending (F-25): adding from the Modules panel keeps focus on the card; a parked module's toast carries Undo.
